title: PRINCIPLES OF PHYSICAL OCEANOGRAPHY
description: Examines fundamental physical principles that govern the behavior of the earth's oceans including conservation of mass, heat, momentum, and vorticity. Presents equations governing motion in the ocean, geostrophy, planetary boundary layers, and wind-driven and thermohaline circulation. Emphasizes large-scale circulation and climate, and regional and topical aspects, such as coastal upwelling, El Niño, and the influence of physical dynamics on biological and chemical processes. Discusses ocean composition and essential fluid dynamics, especially the earth's global energy balance, and the non-intuitive behavior of fluids on a rotating planet.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: OC 298 and (MTH 252Z, 252HZ, 252 or 252H) and (PH 201, 211 or 211H) and (PH 202, 212 or 212H).
A minimum grade of C- is required in OC 298, MTH 252Z, MTH 252HZ, MTH 252, MTH 252H, PH 201, PH 211, PH 211H, PH 202, PH 212 and PH 212H.
